units.source_text: 角上一个房间里，另有几个侍女，穿着龌龊不堪的白衣服，外面罩着污旧的罩裙，样子真难看。

en.t: In a room at the corner, there were several other maidservants, wearing filthy white robes with stained old overskirts over them, and they looked truly unsightly.

units.source_text: 她们就在挂下的额发上插一个梳子，表示她们是陪膳的侍女[\[6\]](#part1335.html#m6)，样子很像内教坊里练习音乐的老妇人，或者内侍所里的老巫女，教人看了觉得好笑。

en.t: They had each stuck a comb into the hair hanging over the forehead to show that they were serving maids at table[\[6\]](#part1335.html#m6); they looked very much like old women practicing music in the court music office, or aged shrine women of the Naishi office, and the sight of them was laughable.

units.source_text: 现代的贵族人家有这种古风的侍女[\[7\]](#part1335.html#m7)，是源氏公子所意想不到的。

en.t: That a noble household of the present day should have such old-fashioned maidservants[\[7\]](#part1335.html#m7) was something Prince Genji had never expected.

units.source_text: 其中有一个侍女说：“唉，今年好冷！

en.t: One of the maidservants among them said, "Ah, it is so cold this year!

units.source_text: 想不到我活了这么大年纪，遭到这种境况！”

en.t: I never imagined that, after living to such an old age, I would end up in circumstances like these!"
As she spoke, tears began to fall.

units.source_text: 另一个人说：“回想起来，从前千岁爷在世之时，我们真不该叹苦；

en.t: Another said, "When I think back on it, in the days when our long-lived lord was still alive, we truly had no right to complain of hardship;

units.source_text: 像现在这种凄惨的日子，我们也得过下去呢！”

en.t: yet now we must somehow go on living through miserable days like these!"

units.source_text: 这人冷得浑身发抖，好像要跳起来的样子。

en.t: This woman was shivering all over from the cold and looked as though she might leap up at any moment.

units.source_text: 她们这样那样地互相愁穷，源氏公子听了心里着实难过，便离开这地方，装作刚才来到的样子，敲敲那扇格子门。

en.t: As they lamented their poverty to one another in this way, Prince Genji listened and felt genuinely distressed; he therefore left the spot, pretended that he had only just arrived, and knocked on that lattice door.

units.source_text: 但闻里面的侍女惊慌地相告：“来了，来了！”

en.t: From inside he heard the maidservants anxiously telling one another, "He has come, he has come!"

units.source_text: 便剔亮灯火，开了门，让源氏公子进来。

en.t: They then trimmed the lamp brighter, opened the door, and let Prince Genji come in.
